Commentary.Commentary: The Lankan bowling started off really well. They made great use of the conditions first up but then ran out of gas. Lahiru Kumara though bowled his heart out as he finished with a four-wicket haul. He was well supported by Lakmal who also did extremely well. However, the spinners who Sri Lanka are very dependent on disappointed and they are now staring down a big first innings score. They now will have to put all that behind and concentrate on their batting. First they will try and battle out the overs remaining today. Whereas, the Windies will try and pick a few wickets. Will the the hosts continue dominating or will Sri Lanka fight back on a wicket which until now seems to be a good batting deck? We will find that out. Join us in a while.

The Windies lower order capitalized on that and build three consecutive 50-run stands. First it was the stand between Holder and Dowrich which accounted for 90. But the 102-run stand between Bishoo and Dowrich hurt Sri Lanka the most. If that was not enough another 75-run stand between Roach and Shane rubbed salt to the wound. They all played a perfect foil to Dowrich who scored his second Test ton and justified Holder's decision of batting first.

Jason Holder has called them back which means the Windies have DECLARED on 414! A brilliant first innings score courtesy Shane Dowrich who walks off to a standing ovation by his teammates. He along with the lower order has taken the Windies to a strong position in the game. They were down and out at 147 for 5 when Sri Lanka had their tails up in the first two sessions of Day 1 with Lahiru Kumara and Suranga Lakmal running through the top order. But as the day progressed they showed signs of tiring. They were sloppy in the field and also their bowling did not have the same consistency.
Good length on off, it straightens a touch. Cummins tries to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes on the bounce to the third slip fielder.
A bumper and the batsman ducks under it.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Good delivery! On a length around off, it straightens after pitching. Cummins tries to defend but gets beaten.
Wide outside off, Cummins lets it be. Not a good ball to bowl first up to a new batsman. Had to make him play there.
Miguel Cummins is the next man in. Will Windies get another 50-run stand? Last three wickets did so and the odds are not against them.
Drinks break.

OUT! In the air and taken! Chandimal takes a superb catch to end the 75-run stand. This was bowled a touch fuller on off. Roach tries to clear mid off who was in the ring. He does hit it well but does not get the desired elevation. It goes hard and uppishly towards Chandimal who times his jump to perfection and takes it with two hands above his head. The Sri Lankan skipper did really well to hang on there as that was traveling. Nevertheless, a good innings by Roach comes to an end. He is Lahiru's fourth wicket. Can he get a fifer?
Lahiru Kumara is brought back into the attack.
Works it with the angle through mid-wicket for another single. So runs are starting to come now. Only 4 from this over but 19 from the last two.
Slightly short on middle, Dowrich goes for the pull shot but is hurried by the pace of the delivery. He hits it towards mid on. Herath runs to his right, misfields but does not concede an extra run.
Driven towards the mid on region.
Good length on off, Dowrich is solid in defense.
Another length ball on middle, Roach this time walks across and works it on the leg side for a run. He is now 12 short of a half ton.
Lakmal bowls it on the pads, Dowrich works it around the corner and gets to the other end.
Suranga Lakmal is back on.
EDGY FOUR! 15 from the over! Dilruwan changes his angle and goes around the wicket. He darts it outside off. Roach slashes but he gets an outside edge past the first slip fielder for a boundary.

SIX! That has gone all the way! Roach is starting to enjoy himself here as he hits the first biggie of the game. Dilruwan once again pays the price for tossing it up. It lands right where Roach likes it. He tonks it over the long on fence for a maximum.
Fires it on off, Roach drives it back to the bowler.
Flatter on off, this time Dilruwan does not make the mistake of tossing it up. Roach defends it onto the ground.
FOUR! He hits it straight as an arrow to bring the 400 up. Stand and deliver stuff from Roach. This is very full on middle, Kemar lofts it over the bowler for a one bounce boundary.
Another sweep shot but he hits it to the fielder at deep square leg for a run.
Sweeps it to the man at deep backward square leg for a run.
Works it with the angle to mid-wicket.
Flatter and outside off, Dowrich goes back and cuts it to point.
Slower through the air on the pads, the batsman works it to the man at mid-wicket. He fumbles but no runs conceded.
Flatter on off, Dowrich guides it to point.
Tosses it up on off, the batsman defends it.
Rangana Herath is back on.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated off break, Roach gets right behind the line of the delivery and defends it out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

NOT OUT! Surprise, suprise! The ball tracking shows missing wickets and Roach survives! A successful review for the home team. Loopy ball on middle and leg stump line from Dilruwan Perera, Roach goes for the ugly heave across the line, tries to play it with the spin but fails to connect. The ball hits him on the pads and the players go up in a flash. The umpire is quick to raise his finger. Roach has a glance at his partner and decides to take it upstairs. First thing first, no issue with the front foot and we move further. There is no inside edge as well. The ball tracking shows missing the leg stump and the Windies pacer survives to fight another day.
Roach decides to challenge the on-field call. He has been adjudged LBW but he wants to take it upstairs. Did he get an inside edge? Not sure, he however is pretty confident about it.
Pushes it through the air, the batsman drills it down the ground for a single.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Roach swings his bat across the line and gets it off the inner half to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short again, Dowrich cuts it through point. There is a man in the deep and he keeps it down to two.
This is nicely hit through covers for a run.

FOUR! 50-run stand between the two and it is the third consecutive one for Windies in this innings. Another frustrating one for Sri Lanka but a meaningful one for the hosts. However, they do not bring the milestone up in convincing fashion. It is a tossed up delivery. Roach tries to go inside out but slices it over the man at point for a boundary.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
FOUR! A hit me ball and Dowrich says thank you so much. He surely won't miss out there. A half-tracker on middle, Dowrich rocks back and whips it through mid-wicket for another boundary.
Loopy ball on middle, eased to mid on.
Quicker on off, Roach this time goes back and defends it.
Time for a part-timer! Kusal Mendis is into the attack.
Flatter on off, Roach comes forward and blocks it.
Top shot again but does not find the gap! Gives it air on off, it lands on the fuller length. Roach drives it hard but to the man at covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
And again quite easily lunges and then defends it.
Flatter and on off, Roach goes back and defends it. Roach has not looked in any kind of trouble out there.
Dowrich who has batted for a long time might be suffering from cramps here. The physio has made his way out to the middle and the batter is receiving a massage.
Another short ball at the rib cage of the batsman. Roach however, was ready for it. He gets into position early and then works it past the leg gully fielder for a run.
Oh yes, but not the desired bounce. It is outside off, it shoots off the surface. Roach tries to defend it off the back foot but it goes underneath the bat.
A short leg now comes in, also a leg gully in place. Time for some short stuff?

FOUR! Strong shot that from Roach! Kumara goes full and on off, looking for a yorker but misses by an inch. It ends up being a half-volley. Roach plays it past the bowler with a straight bat and a boundary results.
Back of a length on off, Roach off the back foot defends it onto the ground.
Fuller and on middle, Roach brings his wrists into play as he clips it through mid-wicket and bags a brace.
Goes full but the line is a little too straight. Dowrich flicks it to the man at deep mid-wicket for a run.
Floats it up on middle, it turns into the batsman. Roach misses the flick and gets hit on the pads.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Eases this down to long on for a run.
Good effort by the veteran, Herath! Roach slams this full ball towards wide mid off. Herath runs to his left, dives and makes a good stop. Saves three for his side.
Smart bowling! Slows this on up on off, it turns and bounces. Roach tries to defend but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Fires this on the pads, Roach very stylishly flicks it but the ball hits the fielder at short leg.
He finds the gap this time but only a single. He pushes it through covers and gets to the other end. Windies are now 30 short of the 400-run mark.
All those dots may have frustrated Roach as he backs away. Maybe a little too much. Kumara bowls it outside off. Roach fails to reach it.
Another good shot by Roach but he is finding the fielders. Full and on off, he times it well but straight to covers. The fielder there misfields but no runs conceded.
Behind a length on off, Roach opens the face of the bat and guides it to gully.
A yorker but the line is outside off, Shane squeezes it through point and gets to the other end.
Back of a length on middle, Dowrich defends it onto the ground.
Fires it on off, Dowrich waits for it and then guides it through third man to retain strike for the next over.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Gives this one air on off, Dowrich drives it back to the bowler.
Eases this off the back foot to mid on.
Loopy ball on off, Dowrich comes forward and defends it.
Flatter and on off, Dowrich pushes it back to the bowler.
Dilruwan Perera is brought back into the attack.

FOUR leg byes! Full marks to the bowler there but it goes for a boundary! A fast bouncer and a well-directed one. Roach tries to duck but it hits the helmet and lobs over the keeper and into the third man fence. Good gesture from the bowler as he asks the batsman whether he is all right and he gets a positive answer.
Back of a length on off, Roach guides it to point.
Roach is not holding back here! He throws the kitchen sink at the ball outside off but does not make contact.
A bumper on middle, the batsman ducks under it.
Length ball on middle, defended.

In the air but safe! Just ahead of a length on off, Dowrich drives it uppishly towards the cover fielder. He sets off for a run. The fielder there dives, collects the ball on the bounce and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Had he hit there, it would have been a terrific effort and also Sri Lanka would have got the wicket of Dowrich.
Lahiru Kumara is back on.
Flighted ball on middle, Roach defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Take that, says Roach! Herath tosses this up, enticing the batsman to go big. Roach does and he does well. He hits it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Loopy ball on off, Roach comes forward and defends it.
Tucks it around the corner with the angle for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slower through the air on off, Dowrich plays a forward defensive stroke.
Another confident-looking stroke. This is on a length and around off, Roach on the up, strokes it to the man at covers.
A single off the fifth. This is on the pads. Shane works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Four dots now! Back of a length on off, Dowrich stands tall and pushes it to mid on. They are in no hurry here, are the Windies batsmen.
A little too wide outside off and Dowrich decides to not play at it.
Another ball on the off stump. Dowrich gets behind the line of it and defends it to mid off.
Length and attacking the stumps. Dowrich defends it towards covers.
Good shot but no runs! Flighted ball on off, Roach drives it to the man at covers. That was right off the middle but straight to the fielder.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slower through the air on off, Roach prods forward and blocks it.
Chandimal calls for another helmet and he is the one now wearing it. He has positioned himself at silly point.
A muted appeal but nothing from the umpire. This is bowled on the pads, Roach comes forward to defend. He misses to get hit on the pads.
Attacks the stumps, Roach gets right to the pitch of it and defends it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball outside off, the batsman plays a drive towards mid off, the fielder from covers runs to his right to stop that but fails to block it cleanly. Single taken.
Fuller in length on off, it is driven to covers. Another testing over by Lakmal comes to an end. He has been brilliant but luck is not on his side today.
Angles this one in but bowls it a little too straight. Roach tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
This time he gets bat to ball as he defends it to mid on.
Two in a row! But not a lot can a batsman do about that delivery. He just has to hope it misses the edge. This is bowled on off and then shapes away late. Roach pokes at it and gets beaten.

Add one more to the number of deliveries which has beaten the outside edge on Lakmal's bowling. Once again hits the length hard on off, it jags away after pitching. Roach has a feel for it but gets beaten.
Tight lines! On a length and around off, the batsman can only defend it off the back foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Top shot! Excellent use of the feet. He gets to the pitch of it and smashes it past the bowler and a boundary results.
Floats it up on middle, Shane pushes it back to the bowler.
Tucks it to the man at mid-wicket with the angle.
Loopy ball on off, Dowrich leans into it and strokes it to the man at covers.
Slower through the air outside off, Dowrich does not play at it.
Rangana Herath to bowl from the other end.
Another solid defense to a ball on off by the Windies bowler.
Goes fuller this time but gets no swing. Roach easily keeps it out.

PEACH! How unlucky has Lakmal been? How many times have we seen him beat the outside edge? I have lost count. He comes running in and angles one into the batsman. He gets it to leave him late. Roach tries to keep it out off the back foot but gets beaten.
Another ball outside off, Roach again goes for a booming drive but does not connect.
Roach now is not holding back. He too goes after a ball which is outside off but does not connect. So after the first two balls one thing is for sure, the two out there are looking for quick runs.
Intent straightaway from Dowrich. He goes after a wide ball outside off. He drives it square on the off side. There is a sweeper in the deep so only a single results.

The players are out for the final phase of the day. We have 35 overs to go so we are surely in for a long session. Shane Dowrich and Kemar Roach will continue from where they left off before the break. Suranga Lakmal will start the proceedings for the visitors. Here we go...
... Day 2, Session 3...

A fruitful session for the home team. They have played with a lot of grit and determination. The brilliant 102-run stand between Bishoo and Dowrich has got the hosts in the ascendancy. The former fell 10 short of a well-deserving half century, but his partner didn't disappoint. The wicket-keeper batsman went a step ahead and registered his second Test ton. He has Roach for company as the Windies team will look to add quick runs in the next session. For Sri Lanka, all the bowlers tried their best but they hardly got any assistance from the surface. The travelers still need to pick three wicket which they will look to get quickly. Can they do so or will they be made to toil in the field again? We will find it out in the last session of the day. Join us back in a while for it.

There it is! Second Test ton for Shane Dowrich, what an effort from this young lad! The entire team is out in the balcony to applaud his effort. He came out to bat with his team in dire straits but showed great character under pressure and has ensured his team has a firm grip on this game. Coming to the ball, it is a flatter one on the leg stump line from Herath and the batsman tucks it to square leg for a single. 350 up for West Indies as well. That will be TEA ON DAY 2!

Top edge... it lands safely and Dowrich gets couple more. He moves to 99! Faster one on the middle and leg stump line from Herath, the batsman looks to play the sweep but gets a top edge over the keeper. Mathews from first slip rushes after it but doesn't get there in time. Can get to three digits before the interval? He has just a solitary ball to do it in.
Serves up a faster one outside off, Dowrich defends it.
Tosses it full outside off, the wicket-keeper batsman is content in spending time at the crease.
Floated delivery, defended down the track.
Arm ball on middle, Dowrich takes a step out and pushes it back to Herath.
Stays low, a fuller length ball, keeps low, luckily for Roach it is outside off and he leaves it with ease. Sixth maiden over from Gamage.
Tries a shortish delivery but the right-hander leaves it with ease.
Fullish delivery from Gamage, the batsman plays a drive to mid off.
Short of a length ball outside off, Roach dabs it to the gully fielder.
Gamage bowls it on a length outside off, the batsman lets it through.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
A little too full on off, this time, the spin is out of contention. Dowrich drives it down to mid off. A good over by Herath comes to an end.

Bounce! Probably the second delivery in the last few overs which has misbehaved. Herath slows it up and bowls it on off, this one turns and then takes off after pitching. Dowrich lunges forward to defend but is surprised by the extra bounce. The ball hits the higher portion of the bat but luckily for him it falls safe on the off side.
Another loopy ball on middle, Dowrich this time plays it with a straight bat as he keeps it out.

Leading edge... but short! Herath slows it up and bowls it on middle, it turns away ever so slightly. Dowrich makes the mistake of playing across the line. He closes the face of the bat early, takes the leading edge and falls just short of Hearth who dives to his right.
Attacks the stumps on off, no spin for the veteran. Easy for Dowrich as he blocks it out.
Floats it up on off, Dowrich plants his front foot forward and keeps it out.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Left alone by Kemar Roach.
Well outside off and the batsman decides to leave it.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Seam up delivery, tails in a little, Roach gets hit on the front leg as he misses the ball. An optimistic shout for LBW but the umpire is unmoved.
FOUR! Wonderful shot! An overpitched delivery outside off, Roach gets closer to the pitch of it and carves it in front of point. The ball speeds away to the boundary. Well-timed by Roach.
Full ball, driven back to the bowler. Dowrich remains on 97. Maiden over from Herath.
Flatter ball on the middle and leg stump line, Dowrich taps it to mid-wicket.
Pushes it to covers, Chandimal there slides to his left and makes a good stop.
Full ball and the right-hander plays a drive back to the bowler.
Another solid front foot defensive stroke from Shane Dowrich.
Pushes it quicker through the air and the batsman defends it.
Good length ball on off, Roach plays with the angled bat and taps it to backward point.
Dangles the carrot outside off and Roach nearly gets sucked into it. He goes after a wide delivery and almost ends up getting an edge through to the keeper.
On the middle and leg stump line, Dowrich works it to the right of Herath at mid on for a single.
Widish delivery outside off and Dowrich lets it through to the keeper.
Fractionally wide from Gamage and the batsman opts to leave.
Serves a fullish delivery on off, Dowrich plays a drive to mid off.
Floated delivery on middle, Roach defends and ends the over with a dot.
Lahiru Gamage is back into the attack.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Risky single! Full ball, Dowrich pushes it to mid on and calls for a quick single. He timed it a little too well than he expected. A direct hit there would have made things interesting.
Defended by Dowrich on the off side.
Darts this on middle and leg stump line, Dowrich defends it out.
Spin for Herath. That one drifts in and grips sharply after pitching, Dowrich lunges forward to defend that but he is beaten comprehensively.
Ends his over with a delivery down the leg side, Roach looks to glance that but he is once again unsuccessful in his attempt.
Another tired effort from Lakmal, bowls a shortish delivery wide outside off, the batsman leaves it all alone.
Spraying it down the leg side. Lakmal loses his radar and Roach looks to cash in on it. He jumps back to glance that but fails to connect.
Serves up a good length ball, on middle and leg. The batsman jumps across and taps it to mid-wicket.
Roach sits on the back foot and taps it square on to the off side.
Dowrich drops it on to the leg side and calls for a quick single. Makes it safely.
Short of a length ball, angling in, Roach goes back to work that on the leg side but he gets hit on the pads.
Pushes it quicker through the air and gets a similar response from Roach. Defended down the track.
Faster one outside off, Roach goes on the back foot to cut that but he fails to make contact with the ball.
Defends it down the track.
Replica of the previous ball. Roach comes forward and blocks it.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Roach gets quite low and defends it solidly.
Pushes it gently towards mid off.
Slipping down leg, the batsman looks to glance that but misses it.
Good length ball on the leg stump line, Dowrich goes across to flick that but misses it on the pads.

NOT OUT! An unsuccessful review, the travelling team have lost a review. Another excellent call from Aleem Dar. Good length ball from Lakmal, he bowls it from wide of the crease, angling in and straightens, Dowrich goes on the back foot to defend that but he misses it. There is a deflection as it goes past his back leg. Huge appeal but the umpire is motionless. Chandimal signals the 'T' and sends the case upstairs. No spike on the Ultra Edge as the ball goes past the outside edge of the bat. As we roll on further, we can see few spikes on it when the ball goes past his back leg.
Another review from Sri Lanka, will they get it overturned this time? A huge appeal for caught behind and the visitors are absolutely convinced. Let's wait for the replays.
Good length ball on off, the batsman goes back and pushes it to the cover region.
Dowrich gets right behind the line of a good length ball and defends it solidly.
Gives it air on middle, Roach lunges forward and keeps it out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy ball on off, Roach easily defends it onto the ground.
The slider on middle, Dowrich off the back foot works it through square leg for a run.
Floats it up on off, Dowrich drives it towards the man at covers.
Fires it on middle, Dowrich goes onto the back foot and defends it. The ball hits the toe end of the bat as it stayed a touch low.
Roach defends it with the straight bat.

NOT OUT! Umpire's call and Roach survives. Sri Lanka haven't got the desired result but they won't lose a review though! Good length ball, angling in from outside off, the batsman stays back and tries to defend that but misses it. The ball hits him on the pads. There is a loud shout but the umpire stays put. The Sri Lankan fielders after having a chat decide to take the review. Ball tracking shows wickets hitting is umpire's call, so the on-field decision stands.
Review time! Appeal for an LBW, turned down. Chandimal takes his time but decides to challenge decision. Will they be successful on this occasion?
Angling down leg, the batsman looks to glance that but misses it.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Beaten! Good ball from Lakmal. Bowls it on a length around off stump, the batsman looks to defend that but he is beaten by the away swing.
Kemar Roach strides out to bat.

OUT! At last, a wicket for Sri Lanka! It took the visitors 299 deliveries to break the seventh-wicket stand! Bishoo played really well but he will still be disappointed with that shot. Lakmal bowls a widish delivery outside off, angling further away from the batsman, who couldn't resist. He throws his bat at it and slices it to gully. Roshen Silva there holds on to a sharp chance. End of a brilliant partnership for the Windies. The smiles are now back on the faces of the Sri Lankan fielders. They now will want to clean up the tail as quickly as possible.
Dowrich flicks it to mid-wicket. Once again, he finds that man.
Drops it short on the stump and the batsman dabs it to mid-wicket.
Floated delivery on off, Bishoo gets down to the other end with a single. Eased it to long on by getting to the pitch of it.
Slider on the leg stump line, the batsman works it to square leg for a single.
Loopy ball on off, Dowrich gets on the front foot and blocks it.
Herath comes back for a new spell. Starts with an arm ball, the batsman flicks it to mid on.
Good length on middle, Bishoo keeps it out off the front foot. End of a testing over by Lakmal.
Angles this into the pads, Bishoo tries to flick it but misses to get hit on the pads. The keeper appeals but he is the only one doing so.
Comes from around the wicket and bowls it a touch outside off. He swings it back in but not enough to make the batsman play.
The inswinger this time from off. Bishoo however, gets behind the line of the delivery and keeps it out.
Was there an edge? No but a very good delivery that. On a length and around off, this one slants away from the left-hander. Bishoo tries to defend it but is beaten.
Right on the money first up! On a length around middle, Bishoo lunges and defends it back to the bowler.
Faster one down the leg side, the batsman sits back to glance that, but misses.
Shortish delivery, the batsman taps it on the leg side.

FOUR! Loopy ball on the leg stump line, Dowrich goes across and sweeps it fine past the keeper. The ball speeds to the fine leg boundary. Brings up the 100-run partnership with Bishoo for the seventh wicket. This has been a phenomenal effort from the two and it has given Windies the upper hand today.
Slanting down the leg side and the batsman doesn't play at it.
Looks to play the sweep, but fails to make contact with the ball. Muted appeal for caught behind by Dickwella but nobody else joined him.
Loopy ball on the leg stump line, the batsman taps it to mid-wicket.
Short of a length ball, the batsman lets it go.
Change of angle, Kumara bowls from around the wicket, bangs it in short and angling in sharply, Bishoo misses it to the keeper.
Short of a length ball, the batsman stands tall and defends it with utmost ease.
Bumper, it lobs over the batsman, who doesn't offer a stroke to it.
FOUR! Smartly played! Shortish delivery, Bishoo moves right across his stumps and glances it nicely past the keeper. The ball races towards the fine leg fence.
Length ball outside off, Bishoo taps it to extra cover.
Darts it down the leg side, Dowrich pads it. Stifled appeal from the bowler, but the umpire is unmoved.
Bishoo sweeps it flat and hard to deep square leg for a single.
Pushes it to long on for a single. This is now the highest partnership (91 runs) for Windies in this innings.
Slider down the leg side, the batsman doesn't play at it.
Loopy ball on the leg stump line, Dowrich defends it solidly.
Flatter ball, the batsman tucks it to the square leg region.
Short of a length ball on the stumps, Bishoo backs away and taps it down the track.
Smell the leather stuff from Kumara! Bangs it in short and into the face of Bishoo, who takes his eyes off it as he ducks under.

FOUR! False shot from Bishoo! Top edge... but it flies over the keeper! Pacey short ball and the batsman goes for the pull. He is clearly late on it and gets a top edge. The ball just bounces inside the ropes at fine leg.
Length ball on off, the batsman jumps across and taps it to the right of the mid-wicket fielder for a run
Eases it in the gap on the off side and they cross over.
Bumper down the leg side, Bishoo goes for the pull but fails to make contact with the leather.
Leg bye! Serves it down the leg side and Bishoo misses it and gets pinged on the pads. Belated decision to take the run and they get it safely.
Faster one on the stumps, the left-hander dabs it to covers.
Plays it a little too early and gets a leading edge down the track.
Bishoo moves inside the line of it and sweeps to short fine leg.
Gives it more revs, Bishoo gets on the front foot and taps it to short leg.
Slider outside off, Dowrich jabs at that one and the ball goes off the outer half. It rolls to third man and they collect a single.
Drinks break.
Ends the over with a length ball on off and middle, defended by the batsman.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it but misses.
On the rib cage and Bishoo taps it on the leg side.

Effort ball, Kumara bends his back and digs this short, Bishoo keeps his hands low and lets it through to the keeper. Extended followthrough by the bowler, gives a stare to the batsman, who isn't bothered by it.
Attacks the body with a short of a length ball. Bishoo dabs it on the leg side.
Shortish delivery to start the new spell, Bishoo moves out of the way and leaves it alone.
Lahiru Kumara comes back for a new spell.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Gives it air on middle, Bishoo pushes it down to long on.
DEFT! This is flatter and outside off, Bishoo goes back, waits for the ball and then guides it through short third man for a brace. He is now 15 short.
Sweeps it down to backward square leg for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Excitement out in the middle! This is floated up on leg stump. Bishoo tries to defend but it hits the pad and goes to the man at first slip.
This is wide outside off, Dowrich is in no mood to go after it.
Back of a length on off, it is guided to point.
Fuller on middle, Bishoo works it through square leg for a run.
Another bumper and Bishoo ducks under it.
FOUR! Bishoo finally connects with the pull shot! It was short and down the leg side. It was there for the taking and Bishoo helps it on its way to the fine leg fence. A boundary after 84 balls.
Swing for Gamage but at his pace, Dowrich has no trouble. Fuller and tailing back in. Shane clips it through mid-wicket and moves to 83.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted ball on leg. Bishoo strokes it to mid on for another dot.
Flatter on off, guided to point.
Loopy ball on off, blocked.
Flatter on middle, defended.
Works it with the turn towards deep square leg for a run. He is now 18 short of a well-deserved ton.
Shortish on off, Bishoo pushes it off the back foot.
A good bumper on middle. The bowler bent his back on that one. Bishoo does really well to defend it onto the ground.
A short ball but once again it is down the leg side. Bishoo ducks under it.
Opens the face of the bat and guides it to vacant point region. Single taken.
Serves up a good length ball on middle, the batsman blocks it right under his eyes.
Tailing in from outside off, the batsman hangs back and taps it on to the leg side.
Drifts in from outside off, the left-hander drives it down the track towards the bowler.
Flatter ball from Perera outside off, Bishoo gets on the front foot and defends.
Pushes it quicker through the air and Bishoo defends it.
Flatter ball on the pads, Shane works it with the spin towards deep square leg for a single.
The batsman presents the full face and pushes it back to the bowler.
Loopy off break on the off stump line, Dowrich covers the line of it and defends it with the straight bat.
A wide ball outside off, Bishoo is not tempted as he makes a leave. Don't think that tactic will work as he has showed tremendous patience. He has faced 112 balls for his 23.
Good length and on off, Bishoo is solid in defense.

A brace! Not in convincing manner but Bishoo will take it with open arms. On a length around off, Bishoo tries to defend but it goes off the outer half towards third man. Lakmal gives it chase from point and keeps it down to two.
Another dot! The bowler goes fuller this time on off, Bishoo lunges and blocks it. Too easy as there is no swing or seam available out there now.
Back of a length and angling across. Bishoo gets behind the line and defends it.
Goes for a bumper first up. It is down the leg side. Bishoo goes for the pull but does not connect.
Lahiru Gamage is back on.
Flatter on off, Dowrich keeps it out. The series of tight overs continues.
Loopy ball on off, Dowrich is in no hurry here as he prods forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
On the pads, too easy for Bishoo as he nudges it fine on the leg side for a run.
Another tossed up ball on off, Shane pushes it down to long on for an easy run.
Floated it up on middle, Dowrich easily keeps it out.
Flatter and on off, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Flighted ball on off, it is defended off the front foot. Another tight over, the spinners are keeping it nice and tight but they need to pick wickets here.
Eases it down to long off for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Pulls his length back a touch. Dowrich defends it to covers.
Loopy ball and on the fuller side. Dowrich drives it to the man at covers.
Floats it up on off, Dowrich defends it onto the ground.
Pushes it with the turn to the man at mid on.
Stroked down to long on for a run.
The batsman plays the square cut. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Shorter on middle, Bishoo pushes it to the man at covers.
Flatter on the stumps, blocked.
On the stumps, kept out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Guided through point for a run. It brings up the 300. Who would have thought they would get to this mark when they lost their fifth wicket. It has been a commendable effort by the lower order and they are still not finished.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Eases it through mid off for a run.
Stays low! However, the batsman need not worry about it as it was down the leg side. Dowrich misses the flick and the keeper does well to collect it by going low.
Loopy ball on off, the batsman defends it easily.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Action replay of the last delivery.
Floats it up in the line of the stumps. The batsman lunges forward and defends it.
Fires it on middle, Bishoo blocks it off the back foot.
On the stumps and kept out.
Flighted ball on off, Bishoo with the turn pushes it to point.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Changes his pace and bowls it flatter on the stumps. Dowrich has all the time in the world to rock back and keeps it out.
On the stumps, Dowrich has no problem in defending it.
Gives it air on off, defended.
Loopy ball on off, it is eased to mid off.
The physio comes out to have a look and now Mendis is limping of the field. Not a good sign for Sri Lanka as he is an important batsman for them. They will hope it is not something serious.

Ouch! That must have hurt! Dowrich sweeps this ball right off the middle but it hits Mendis right on the knee. He is now down on the ground. Not an easy place to field is that short leg region. You are always in the firing line.
Gives it air and bowls it on middle, Bishoo pushes it to mid on.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On middle, Bishoo tries to keep it out but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Gives it air on off, Bishoo prods forward and blocks it.
Flatter and on the stumps, Bishoo lunges forward and defends it.
Works it with the turn to the man at mid-wicket for a run. 2 runs short of 300 now are the Windies.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
This is on the shorter side but a touch quicker. Bishoo pushes it to covers.
Another flatter delivery on off, does not turn at all. Bishoo gets behind the line of the delivery and keeps it out.
Flatter on off, Bishoo keeps it out of the back foot.
Loopy ball on off, blocked.
Beautifully bowled! This is tossed up outside off, it is the arm ball. Bishoo plays inside the line and gets beaten.
From around the wicket. He bowls it on middle. The batsman defends it.
Outside off, Bishoo who is now building in confidence, strokes it through covers for a run.
On the stumps and Bishoo keeps it out.
Flatter and offers a little room outside off. Bishoo pushes it through covers and gets two.
Flatter on off, Dowrich rocks back and pushes it down to long on for a run.
Eases it down to mid on.
Flicks it to the leg side with the turn.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy ball on off, kept out.
Flighted ball on off, Bishoo defends it onto the ground.

FOUR but a half chance there! A half-hearted effort you can say! Herath floats it up on off, Bishoo shows sign of aggression as he tries to clear mid off by stepping out. He mistimes it and it goes uppishly towards Kumara there. He runs across to his left a touch lazily and stretches his hand out but fails to reach it. The ball then trickles away to the fence.
Works it with the angle through mid-wicket for a run.
Rangana Herath is into the attack.
Slight turn there! Dilruwan floats it up on off, it turns away. Bishoo tries to keep it out but it goes off the outer half towards point.
Loopy ball on off, Bishoo prods forward and blocks it.
Fires it on the pads, Bishoo keeps it out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floats it up on off, Bishoo easily keeps it out.
Pushes it towards point for a quick run.

Shortish and on off, Dowrich first thinks of leaving it but then plays a half-hearted shot towards gully, where a fumble from the fielder allows them a single. It also brings the 50-run stand up between the two. A very frustrating one for the visitors.
Another single! This is surely frustrating Sri Lanka even more. On a length around off, Bishoo pushes it through covers and gets to the other end.
Another short ball, this is outside off. Dowrich cuts it towards cover-point. The fielder there makes a good stop but can't prevent the single.
Down the leg side, Dowrich tries to nudge it fine but misses.
Back of a length on off, it is pushed through covers for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Good bowling! It is the straighter one on off. Dowrich plays for the turn but is beaten on the outside edge.
Flatter on off, Dowrich defends it onto the ground.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
This is bowled wide outside off, Dowrich need not play at those.
Floats it up on off, Shane pushes it to mid off.
Down the leg side, Dowrich tries to flick but misses.
Once again goes wide of the crease and angles it into the pads. Dowrich tries to clip it but misses to get hit on the pads. It goes towards square leg and the batsmen run a leg bye.
Goes wide of the crease and angles this one on the pads. Dowrich flicks it through square leg and bags a brace.
Goes fuller this time on off, it is driven to the man at mid off.
A bumper down the leg side, Dowrich does not fiddle with it.
This is down the leg side, Dowrich lets it be.

NOT OUT! Umpire's call! That was more of a desperate review by Sri Lanka. However, they do not lose it. This is bowled on a length and around off, it jags back in after pitching. Dowrich tries to defend it by hopping and moving across but misses. The ball hits him high on the pads. The Lankan players make a loud appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Chandimal decides to take it upstairs. Replays roll in and they show impact to be umpire's call and hitting is also umpire's call. So the on-field call stays.
Howzat? The answer to that question is not out. Chandimal however does not agree and he wants the LBW appeal to be taken upstairs. Dowrich is the man in question. Looks high to me.
A maiden to begin with by Perera. He floats it up on middle, Bishoo is solid in defense.
Bowls it on the stumps, Bishoo defends it to covers.
This is a little too full on off, Bishoo strokes it to covers.
Gives it air and hopes for some purchase out of the surface. Does not get any and Bishoo once again covers the line and keeps it out.
Flatter this time on off and on a shorter length. Bishoo blocks it.
Starts off with a flighted ball on off. It goes on with the arm. Bishoo covers the line and keeps it out.
Dilruwan Perera is into the attack for the first time today.
Bowls it wide outside off, Dowrich lets it be.
Good delivery! This is on a length around off, it comes in with the angle and then straightens after pitching. Dowrich is squared up as he tries to defend and gets beaten.
A bumper on middle, Dowrich ducks under it.

FOUR! Fortune favors the brave! Kumara dishes out a full delivery wanting the batsman to go for a booming drive. Dowrich obliges it and goes for it. He gets a thick outside edge and the ball flies through the vacant third slip region for a boundary. This is very frustrating for Sri Lanka but very handy for the Windies.
Shorter in length, aimed at the rib cage of the batsman. Similar to the delivery he got Hope with. Dowrich tries to play the same shot Hope did but misses.
Poor ball to start with. Down the leg side, Bishoo flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Lahiru Kumara will bowl from the other end.
Nicely timed! This is on a length around off, Dowrich who is timing the ball really well, prods forward and strokes it through covers for a brace.
Bowls it on the off stump this time. Dowrich lunges and pushes it to mid off confidently.

FOUR! Good cricket all around. Excellent delivery. Full and tailing back in late, looking to hit the pads of Dowrich. He though is up for it as he plants his front foot forward and wrists it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Wayward delivery! Down the leg side. Dickwella does well to dive to his left and stop it.
A run straightaway after the break! It is on a length around off, Bishoo pushes it through covers and gets to the other end.

Bright sunshine welcomes us after the break. The Sri Lanka players make their way out to the middle. Shane Dowrich and Devendra Bishoo will resume their innings. Lahiru Gamage will continue his over. He has five balls to go. Here we go...
... Day 2, Session 2...

Update 1220 local time - Promising signs! Conditions are bright and sunny at the moment. All the covers are off and we are just 10 minutes away from the second session. Hope, the weather stays this way for the next few hours.

So, that will be it from this session. Early lunch has been called by the umpires. We hardly had any play this morning and whatever we had, it went in the favor of the hosts. The overnight pair has added 22 runs in 9.1 overs bowled. Dowrich reached his sixth Test fifty, while Bishoo gusted it out. The leggie was troubled largely by the pace of Kumara but he managed to escape the opening burst as the duo went unscathed before the second rain interruption. Let's hope we have better weather for the second session, join us back at 1230 local time.

Update 1130 local time - The rain is back and the umpire calls for the covers. It is getting heavier by every passing second. The groundsmen are quickly into the action and they have covered the main square in no time. Let's hope, it is just another passing shower and we get to see more action before Lunch.
Keeps it fuller on the stumps, Bishoo drives it past the bowler towards mid off.
On a length outside off, Dowrich shoulders arms to it.
Leading edge! Dowrich sits back in his crease to a good length delivery and looks to flick that. The ball swings away a little and he ends up getting a leading edge down the track.
Smart bowling from Lakmal, the previous one he took away from the batsman and this one he brings back in with the angle. Dowrich decides to leave it and the ball goes over the off peg.
A gently away swinger from Lakmal, the batsman covers the line of it and defends it back to the bowler.
Good length ball on off, the batsman goes back in his crease and dabs it to covers.
Dowrich covers his off stump and decides to leave that one.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
FOUR Byes! Oh dear! That's a wayward delivery, well down the leg side and the keeper dives full length to his right to stop that but he fails to stop it.
Slightly wide from Gamage and Bishoo goes on the back foot and lets it through to the keeper.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
The groundsmen are getting busy, hopefully, the rain stays away and we get through this session without any further interruptions.
Bishoo stands tall to defend that, but gets a thick edge wide of the man at second slip for a brace.
Bowls a delivery on the pads and the batsman pushes it to mid on.
Lahiru Gamage comes for a new spell.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Dowrich goes back and looks to defend a straight delivery from Lakmal. The ball catches the inner half and races away to fine leg fence. This is now a highest score (57 runs) by the Windies wicket-keeper batsman against Sri Lanka
Loose shot. An off cutter from Lakmal outside off, the batsman looks to pull that, but fails to make contact.
Dowrich stays right back in the crease and pushes it on the off side.
Jaffa from Lakmal, bowls from wide of the crease and slanting in at pace, the batsman hangs back to defend that, but the ball goes through his defenses and goes over the stumps.
The left-hander sits back and defends it out. Second consecutive maiden for Sri Lanka.
Play and a miss! Still no luck for Kumara, he once again goes past the outside edge of Bishoo' bat without finding the outside edge.
Bishoo stands tall to that one and defends it on the off side.
Shortish delivery outside off, the batsman evades it nicely.

Ripper from Kumara, Bishoo simply had no answers to it! On a good length, pitching on middle and leg, slanting across at pace, Bishoo goes back to defend that but the ball whistles past the outside edge.
Steams in from over the wicket angle, bowls it fuller on the stumps, Bishoo pushes it on the off side.
And that's the sixth one, a maiden over from Lakmal where the batsman didn't put bat to ball.
Make that the fifth leave from Dowrich in this over.
Bowls from wide of the crease, angling it in, the right-handed batsman doesn't offer a stroke to it.
Third leave on the trot from Dowrich, a widish delivery and the batsman is happy to leave those.
Similar delivery from Lakmal and he gets a similar response from the batter.
On a length outside off, Dowrich sits back and lets it through to the keeper.
Bishoo is late on the ball as he tries to dab it down to third man but misses it.
Another effort ball from Kumara, he is giving it everything in this over. Bowls a yorker on middle, Bishoo jams his bat down in time and digs it out.

FOUR! Streaky, but those are useful runs for Windies! Steams in and bowls a good length ball, Bishoo goes back to defend that, but the ball catches the outer half and rolls between third slip and gully. First boundary for Bishoo, his second scoring shot so far!
Pacey nut from Kumara, comes from around the wicket and slants it in. Bishoo hangs his bat aimlessly and the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Plays slightly away from his body and taps it towards backward point.
Bishoo sits back looking to punch that, but he gets an inside edge on the back leg.
Widish delivery and the batsman decides to shoulder arms to it.
Tries a drive, but he gets a bottom edge which goes on the bounce towards first slip.
Left alone by Dowrich.
Dowrich goes back to flick that but misses and gets hit on the pads.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the backfoot.

Massive appeal for caught behind but the umpire is unmoved! Short of a length ball on the off stump line and it moves away a little after pitching, Dowrich misses it as he looks to defend that. The ball goes through to the keeper who collects it and goes up straightaway. Sri Lanka fielders join him later but they fail to eek out a response from the man that matters. After a long chat, Chandimal decides to take the review, however, Aleem Dar says TIME OUT. In a way, a good thing for Sri Lanka as had the review been taken, they would have lost it as Ultra Edge confirms the noise was of the ball hitting the pad and not the bat. An excellent decision by the umpire.
Another easy leave for Bishoo. Kumara needs to get his line right and make him play.
Widish delivery from Kumara, Bishoo doesn't play at that one.
Short outside off, Bishoo goes back to cut that, but he fails to make contact.
Width on offer, Bishoo goes back to cut that, mistimes it on the off side.
Sliding down leg, and the batsman glances it to fine leg for a single.
First run for Bishoo after facing 33 balls, he breaks the sequence of dots. Works it to square leg for a single.
Lahiru Kumara comes into the attack.
Squared him up a little, Dowrich aims to play that on the leg side, he closes the face of the bat early and gets a leading edge on the off side.
Fuller length ball on off, Dowrich pushes it down the track towards mid off.
Slightly wide from Lakmal and the batsman decides to leave it.

FOUR! Bang! Dowrich gets to his fifty in grand style, his sixth in Test cricket! He gets a shortish delivery on the leg stump line. Swivels across and pulls it behind square leg for a boundary. First Windies wicket-keeper to score a fifty against Sri Lanka in West Indies. This has been one important knock from him. His job though is not done yet and he would now want to make it big.
Probing delivery from Lakmal, he gets his act together. Bowls a length ball closer to the off stump, moves away a little and the batsman is beaten all ends up.
Friendly overpitched delivery on the stumps, Dowrich punches it past the bowler. Beats the man at mid off who gives it a chase and keeps them down to two.

The wait is over and it is time for the action to being. It is bright and sunny now as the players make their way out to the middle. Shane Dowrich and Devendra Bishoo will continue their innings. For Sri Lanka, Suranga Lakmal will start the proceedings with the ball. He has a couple of slips and a gully in position. Here we go...

Update 1043 local time - GOOD NEWS! It has stopped raining and the umpires are out. Looking much brighter now. The groundsmen are slowly removing the covers. Let's hope, the weather stays this way and we get to see some action. Fingers crossed!

Update 1008 local time - The rain seems to have eased away and the match officials are out in the middle. But just as I type this, it has started to drizzle again and Aleem Dar has called for more covers. The wait continues...

Update 0958 local time - Oh dear! We don't have good news to start with. The heavens have opened up and it is raining cats and dogs at the moment. Covers are out in the middle, it doesn't look a merry picture at the Queen's Park Oval and we will surely have a delayed start.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the second day. Both the teams had their moments on the opening day of the game but they failed to capitalize on it. Sri Lanka started well with the ball yesterday but missed opportunities costed them dearly. The batsmen from the home team, got starts but failed to convert them. Honors were shared on Day 1, which makes the morning session very important. The Asian team today will look to pick the remaining wickets quickly, while Windies will be hoping to add as many runs as possible. Stay tuned for the action!
... Day 2, Session 1...

Earlier in the day, Windies elected to bat after winning the toss. None of their top order batsmen could make it big. Shai Hope did look promising but he too fell prey to Kumara who finished the day with a three-fer. They were in trouble at 147 for 5 but Holder and Dowrich came to their rescue and now they find themselves in a good position at the end of the day. Windies will now hope the rest along with Shane can take them somewhere close to 300. Whereas, the Sri Lankan bowlers will come out fresh on Thursday and try and bundle out the rest of the Windies' batsmen as quickly as possible. Do join us to find out what will happen on Day 2 of this Test match at 1000 local (1400 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye.

Third session - 93 for 1 in 34 overs! An excellent fightback by the Windies led by Dowrich, who walks off to a standing ovation by his teammates has seen the day end even-stevens. Sri Lanka came into the final phase with the idea of batting today but it was not to be. The resurgent pair of Holder and Dowrich joined forces and built a 90-run stand. They too rode their luck on their way but added vital runs before Lahiru Kumara, the pick of the bowlers, broke through. Bishoo then walked out and he along with Dowrich did well to play the day out. Overall, Sri Lanka were sloppy in the field as they missed quite a few chances.
Another ball which is way outside off. Bishoo does the right thing as he makes another leave. STUMPS ON DAY 1!
Shane will surely applaud that leave. This is closer to the off pole. Bishoo plants his front foot forward and watches it go to the keeper.

The sucker ball way outside off. Bishoo is tempted to go after it with a loose drive. Luckily for him he does not get an edge on that one. Not sure Dowrich will be happy with the shot the leggie just played.
Outside off, left alone.
Shapes in again from off. Dowrich works it down to fine leg for a run.
The inswinger by the bowler from the off stump. Dowrich pushes it to mid on.
Gets swing but the line is wrong. It is down the leg side.
A bumper on off. Bishoo watches it go to the keeper.
Tries to bowl the magic delivery which swings from the leg stump to hit the off pole but the ball goes straight on. Easy for Dowrich as he flicks it to fine leg for a run.
Once again bowls it on a length and around off. Dowrich easily keeps it out.
Good length on middle, Shane is solid in defense.
Back of a length on off, Dowrich tries to defend but the ball takes the inside edge onto the pads.
A dot to finish. Outside off, left alone.
Make that 25! On a length around off, Bishoo keeps it out.
Better from the bowler. He attacks the stumps, Bishoo strokes it to mid off for another dot. He has faced 24 balls and is yet to get off the mark.
Two leaves in a row! Has to make the batsman play. Length outside off, Bishoo shoulders arms to it.
This is erratic by Gamage. This one was very wide outside off. Bishoo need not play at those.
A poor start with the new ball. It is short and on middle, Dowrich is early into the pull shot. It goes off the toe end towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Lahiru Gamage is brought back into the attack.
He maybe reading what I am writing here as he bowls this in the blockhole. It swings in as well. Bishoo does extremely well to dig it out.
Shorter in length on off, Bishoo guides it to point. Maybe Lakmal should be pitching it a little full here.
Good length on off, Bishoo easily gets behind the line and defends it.
Bowls this one outside off, wanting it to shape back in. It does not. Bishoo lets it be.
Errs in line and bowls this one down the leg side.
Lakmal does get a little bit of shape back into the batsman. It is on a length around middle. It is defended.
The second new ball is now available and it has been taken immediately. No surprises there as they got a lot of purchase with it at the start. Also, Suranga Lakmal is back into the attack.
A maiden on his return to the attack as Dowrich lunges and blocks this ball on off.
A little outside off, Dowrich lets it be.
Flighted ball on the stumps, Dowrich defends it onto the ground.
Works it with the angle to mid-wicket.
Floats it up on middle, Dowrich eases it to mid on.
Loopy ball on off, Dowrich defends it solidly.
Rangana Herath comes back on.
Lovely bowling! Uses the angle first and bowls it on off. It pitches and then straightens. Bishoo tries to defend but gets beaten.
Runs all the way upto his mark and then pulls out at the very last moment.
Follows it up with a yorker but the line is not that right. It is slightly outside off. Bishoo jams it out to mid off.
This is what he was expected to bowl, a bouncer. Bishoo does well to evade it.
With a short leg in place, Kumara does not bowl the length expected. He bowls it wide outside off and full, the batsman lets it be.
Shorter in length on off, Dowrich stands tall and punches it wide of mid off. He runs a single.
Back of a length on off, Dowrich guides it to gully.
Negotiates the five balls really well as he blocks this off the back foot.
Darts it on the stumps, it has been defended.
Flatter and on off, Bishoo pushes it to covers.
Floats it up on off, Bishoo drives it to the man at covers.
Fires it on middle, Bishoo defends it onto the ground.
Flatter on middle, Dowrich works it through mid-wicket and takes a single. He is trusting his partner. Also, he knows they do not have a lot on the board and every run could be important.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Tucks it with the angle to square leg and gets to the other end.
Back of a length on off, Dowrich pushes it to covers.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
A yorker on middle, Dowrich keeps it out.

Short and on middle, Dowrich pulls it towards mid on. The fielder there runs to his left and makes a good diving stop. This is the effort Chandimal wants his players to be putting, especially at this time of the day.
Floats it up on middle, Bishoo defends it by lunging forward.
Tucks it around the corner and gets to the other end.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Vicious turn and bounce! This is bowled on off. It shoots off the surface and also turns into the batsman. It spins past the batsman, beats the keeper and the batsmen take two byes.
Flatter on off, Dowrich pushes it to point.
Flatter on middle, Dowrich goes back and tucks it to mid-wicket.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
Wide outside off, left alone.
On the pads, Bishoo tries to keep it out but is hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Short ball down the leg side. Bishoo lets it be.
Devendra Bishoo is the next man in.

OUT! It is bat hitting the ball! Excellent review by Sri Lanka and a lot of credit has to be given to Dickwella who wanted it to be taken straightaway. The dropped catch has not cost them a lot here and Kumara once again delivers when his captain needed him to. He gets his third as he breaks the 90-run stand. This is full and outside off. Holder goes for the booming drive. There is a noise as the ball passes the bat and the Lankan players appeal. The umpire shakes his head. Dickwella straightaway wants it to be reviewed and his skipper signals the 'T'. Replays roll in and Ultra Edge shows there is a spike before the bat hits the ground. Holder is given his marching orders. He too falls after getting a start. Can Sri Lanka now get the remaining wickets quickly?
Review time! A huge appeal for a caught behind. Holder is the man in question. Is it bat hitting the ground or bat hitting the ball? Let us find out.
Another short ball and outside off, Dowrich gets on top of the bounce and cuts it to deep point for a run. The partnership between the two is now 90.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fires it on the stumps, Dowrich defends it onto the ground.
Loopy ball on middle, Holder lofts it towards long on for a run.
Floats it up on middle, Holder defends it on the front foot.
Once again works it to mid-wicket with the turn.
Works it with the turn to mid-wicket.
Fuller ion length by Kumara. Holder strokes it through cover-point for a run.
Now a poor shot by Holder! Easy skipper, they won't be dropping you all the time. Short and outside off, Holder tries to cash in on the width offered with a cut shot but fails to connect.

FOUR BYES! This is lethargic from the Sri Lankans out there. Kumara bowls it wide outside off. Dickwella does not go low enough to collect the ball. He gets fingertips to it and the ball goes past the man at first slip. The ball races away to the third man fence.

Edge... that goes straight towards second slip but he SPILLS IT! The Sri Lankan players are not in the mood to catch the ball in this final session. The bowling change almost did the trick. It is bowled on a shorter length outside off, Holder tries to force it through the off side away from his body. The ball takes the outside edge and goes at a comfortable height to Silva who drops it.
This is an even better shot but finds the fielder in the deep at square leg. Only a run.
FOUR! Welcome back into the attack says Dowrich! Short and wide outside off. A lot of width on offer. Shane pounces on it and slaps it through point for a boundary.
Lahiru Kumara is back on.
Loopy ball on off, Holder tries to play it across the line but gets a soft leading edge to mid off.
Flighted ball on middle, Holder whips it to mid on.
Attacks the stumps and the batsman blocks it.
Floats it up on off, the batsman defends it onto the ground.
Tosses this one up outside off, Holder squirts it through point and gets a brace.
Works it to the man at square leg with the turn.
Goes fuller but does not get any swing. The batsman hits it back to the bowler.
Hits the length area and on off, Dowrich off the back foot keeps it out.
Length ball around off, Shane pushes it to the man at covers.
Goes fuller again on off, Dowrich drives it to covers.
No mid off and Holder drives it through there. Kusal Perera runs to his left from mid on and keeps it down to one. That was quick work from the fielder.
Good length on off, it is defended.
A bit of turn there for the bowler! He tosses this one up outside off, it turns back in sharply. Shane lunges forward to defend but misses to get hit high on the pads.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Floated ball on middle, Holder drives it back towards the bowler who misfields. Holder calls for a run, his partner obliges. The fielder from mid on chases, slides but fails to collect it cleanly.
Flatter and on off, this one turns back in slightly. Dowrich goes on the back foot and tucks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Fires it on the pads, Holder tucks it around the corner and gets to the other end. He moves onto 34.
Flatter and on off, Dowrich goes back and works it through square leg. They run the first one hard but have to settle down for only a single.
Back of a length on off, Holder stands tall and pushes it to short cover.
This time he is quite sure that he wants to play it. Does it well as he defends it onto the ground.

Good length around off, Holder first thinks of playing at it but then tries to pull his bat out at the very last moment. He though is late in doing so and the ball hits the bottom part and goes to the man at gully.
Again it is on a length around off, Dowrich pushes it through covers for a quick run.
Good length delivery outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to it.
Fuller in length on off, the batsman drives it back to the bowler.
Another no ball by Gamage. This is short and outside off, Dowrich mistimes his cut through point for a brace.

Drinks break. This has been a strong comeback from Windies. Shane Dowrich and Jason Holder have defied the Sri Lankan attack so far after Tea. These two have added 66 so far and they will be eager to add plenty more. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, will welcome this break.
The batsman gets right behind it and defends it solidly.
Holder crouches low and taps it on to the leg side.
Waits for it on the back foot and nudges it to square leg for a run.
Fullish delivery on off, Dowrich pushes it back to the bowler.
Slider on middle and leg, Dowrich goes across and taps it on the leg side.
FOUR! Drifts away a little, Dowrich makes room for himself and powers the back foot punch through the covers. Good shot and it fetches him a boundary.
Fuller length ball from Gamage, Holder sits back and defends but the ball goes off the inner half on to his pads.
Drops it short on the stumps, Dowrich gets into position quickly and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller length ball outside off, the batsman pushes it to the cover region.
Touch wide from Gamage, the batsman doesn't offer any stroke to that one.
Plays the square drive but finds the man at backward point.
FOUR! This one stays a little low but Dowrich adjusted well to it. He swivels across and pulls it to perfection to the square leg boundary.
Lahiru Gamage comes into the attack.
Punches it on the other side towards the man at mid on.
Floated delivery and Holder plays a drive to mid off.
Uses his wrists and works it behind square leg. They cross over.
Drops it short and spins in a little, the batsman looks to pull that but gets pinged on the pads. Stifled appeal for an LBW, but the umpire stays put.

Sitter dropped! It's a regulation chance at first slip but Mathews makes a meal of it. A slider from Perera, drifts away a little, the batsman looks to defend that but he ends up getting a thick outside edge to Mathews. The ball goes straight in and comes straight out. A big moment in this session.
Holder gets right to the pitch of it and powers it to long on for a single.
Opens the face of the bat and dabs it to the point region.
Defends it down the track.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Faster one from Herath, at 91 clicks. Dowrich blocks it out.
Offers a dead bat and defends it back to the bowler.
Fires it full on the middle and leg stump line, the batsman taps it on the leg side.
Tossed up off break from Perera, Holder nudges it to mid on. A dot ball to end the over.
Dowrich sits on the back foot and chops it to the vacant point region for a single.
The right-hander works it to square leg for a single. 200 up for Windies!
Holder gets on the front foot and defends another one from Perera.
Works it wide of the man at first slip and they rotate the strike with a single.
Slider on the stumps, Dowrich defends it with the straight bat.
Suranga Lakmal is seen once again leaving the field, he still doesn't seem to be 100 percent. Sri Lanka will be hoping that he gets fit before the new ball is due.
Replica of the previous delivery, Holder blocks another one.
Attacks the stumps, Holder defends it solidly.

FOUR! Brings up the 50-run partnership with Dowrich. An important union for the home team. Floated delivery on middle, Holder backs away and square drives it through point. A teasing chase for the fielder and the ball wins.
Holder defends it out.
Gets a loopy delivery and Dowrich drills it to the left of Herath. Single taken.
Darts it on the stumps, Dowrich defends it off the front foot to mid-wicket.
Makes use of his crease, goes right back and forces it through covers for a brace.
Uses his wrists and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Much slower through the air, the batsman pushes it defensively back to the bowler.
Faster one from Perera, flattler outside off, Dowrich slices it to deep point for a single.
The batsman moves across his stumps and works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Plays for the one that turns, but there is none there and Holder is beaten by the straighter one.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Pushes it down the track past his partner towards mid on.
FOUR! Delightful drive from Dowrich. He leans on the front foot and powers it through the covers for a boundary. Partnership is now worth 42.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Plays a drive to the mid on region.

FOUR! Cries of catch it! That was in the air for quite a while. Loopy delivery on off and middle, Holder goes across and whacks it flat to wide long on, Roshen Silva  runs to his right, covers good ground but fails to get under it. Worse, he fails to stop that cleanly and the ball rolls to the boundary.
The batsman rocks on the back foot and powers it to the mid off region.
Pushes it quicker, 85 kph is the speed. Holder pushes it on the off side.
More revs from Perera, Holder crouches low and taps to mid-wicket.
Uses the depth of his crease and pushes it back to Perera.
Loopy off break on the middle and off stump line, Holder defends it with bat and pad close to each other.
Time for some off spin. Dilruwan Perera is back into the attack.
Defends it solidly.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
Dowrich lunges on the front foot and defends.
Loopy ball, the batsman gets right to the pitch of it and drills it to long on for a single.
Pushes it back to the bowler. Herath dives to his left and makes a good stop.
Slider from Herath, angling down leg, Holder lunges forward to defend that. It lobs to the vacant silly point region. Was there an inside edge? Nope. Replays confirm that.
No venom in that delivery, Dowrich hangs back and defends the short of a length ball comfortably.

Now then! On 55.3 there was a sound as the ball passed the bat. There was no appeal from Dickwella, which was quite uncharacteristic of him. Also there was no appeal from the bowler. Ultra Edge later on showed a spike as the ball passed the bat. Another reprieve for the Windies captain. Can he now make use of these reprieves?
Shortish delivery on off, the batsman keeps his hands low and leaves it all alone.
Back of a length ball outside off, the wicket-keeper batsman jumps back and dabs it to point.
Stays back and drops it on to the leg side.
Works that one off his pads in front of square leg for a single.
FOUR! A buffet ball from Kumara, friendly full toss on off, Holder gets on the front foot and creams it through the covers. Timing takes it to the boundary.
Slightly shorter in length, the batsman cuts it to the point region.
Arm ball on the middle and leg stump line, the right-hander flicks it to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball outside off, the batsman doesn't play at it.
Loopy ball on the stumps, Dowrich pushes it to mid off.
Plays a drive back to the bowler.
Floated delivery on middle and leg, Dowrich defends it down the track.
Rangana Herath is back for a new spell.
Bangs it short to end the over, Holder ducks under it with absolute ease.
Back of a length ball outside off, Holder doesn't play at that one.
A casual shot from Holder, he sees a wide delivery and plays away from the body. Looks to drive on the up but misses. The keeper collects it on the second bounce.
On middle and leg, moving further down leg, Holder tries to glance it but misses. Dickwella moves to his left and collects it safely.
Wide! Too short from Kumara and it balloons well over the batsman. The umpire is quick to signal a wide.
Sharp bumper from Kumara outside off, Holder plays well inside the line of it and leaves it alone to the keeper.
Jaffa! Short of a length ball, angling in at pace and straightening a little, Holder had no clue about it. He goes back to defend that but is beaten neck and crop.
FOUR! Fine connection from Dowrich, he picks up the shortish delivery quickly, goes back and rolls his wrists over it. Pulls it away to the square leg boundary.
Wasted effort from Lakmal, bowls it well wide outside off and Dowrich doesn't play at it.
Full pitched delivery outside off, Dowrich comes forward and pushes it to point.

FOUR Leg byes! Once again, Lakmal errs in line, bowls a delivery down the leg side, the ball kisses the thigh pad of Dowrich as he fails to glance it. The ball flies past the diving Dickwella and races to the fine leg fence.
Lakmal slips it down the leg side, Dowrich doesn't go for it and leaves it to the keeper.
Holder gets it off the outer half to third man for a single.
Defends it down the track.
Down the leg side, the batsman looks to flick that but misses it.

IN THE AIR... falls short of Kusal Perera! Short of a length ball, angling in sharply from outside off, Dowrich is cramped for room as he looks to pull that. He ends up miscuing it, the fielder at mid on runs in quickly but fails to get there in time. Maybe, he was slightly late in reacting.
Hits the deck hard and bangs it in short, Dowrich jumps back and defensively pushes it to covers.
Shortish delivery, Holder stands tall and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Crosses over and gives strike back to Dowrich.
Driven towards the mid on region.
Holder gets an inside edge on the leg side. Single taken.

FOUR byes. Wild delivery, hit a crack? Not sure. On a short of a length outside leg, hits the pitch and jags away sharply. Dickwella had no chance of stopping that one as the ball races to the fine leg fence. Bonus runs for Windies!
Holder stays in his crease and defends it solidly on to the off side.
Opens the face of the bat and looks to guide it. The ball goes off the outer half towards gully.
Peach from Lakmal! An airy-fairy drive from Holder. Bowls from wide of the crease, angling in and then shaping away after pitching. Holder plays a loose drive and he is beaten all ends up.
Plays a drive down the ground past the bowler. Right between mid on and mid off. Holder picks up a couple more for the effort.
Bangs it in short and pushes batsman on the back foot. Dowrich defends it from the crease.
Pushes it to mid on, there is a fumble from the fielder but he recovers quickly and ensures there isn't any run gifted away.
Holder rotates the strike by working it wide of mid on. Single added to the total.
Dowrich closes the face of the bat and works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A sharp nut from Kumara, rises sharply, Dowrich looks to defend that but he is beaten by the pace of Lahiru Kumara.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Lahiru Kumara comes into the attack.

NOT OUT! There are a few spikes on the Ultra Edge as it goes past the inside edge and the on-field decision is overturned! Another successful review by Windies. Fuller length ball from Lakmal, tails in a little and Holder is rapped on the front leg as he looks to defend that one. A massive shout from the players and Aleem Dar makes his decision. Strangely, Holder wasn't sure whether he got a nick and walked towards his partner. After having a chat, Jason decides to take it upstairs. Replays roll in and they show there is a MASSIVE inside edge. Good use of the technology, but how come Holder didn't feel the inside edge? It may have been a very, very faint one. Nevertheless, a reprieve for the Windies' skipper.
That looks plumb! Holder after having a chat with his partner decides to take the referral. Only an inside edge can save him here!
In the channel outside off, Holder sits back and leaves another one to Dickwella.
Away swinger from Lakmal outside off, no shot offered by the West Indian skipper.

Tickled fine! Holder moves inside the line of it and glances it to fine leg. Kumara in the deep rushes to his right and slides as he manages to stop that inside the ropes. A couple added to the total.
Bowls from the edge of the crease and attacks the stumps, Holder blocks it solidly.
A widish delivery from Lakmal to start the fresh session. Holder gets a massive stride forward as he leaves that one.

Welcome back for the final session of the day.  Still 40 overs to be bowled in a day, not sure whether we will get them all. Players are out in the middle once again, Jason Holder and Shane Dowrich will resume their innings. For Sri Lanka, Suranga Lakmal will start the evening session with the ball.
... Day 1, Session 3 ...

A strong comeback by Sri Lanka after the drinks break means they are the happier side heading into Tea. The hosts did start off well with Hope and Chase stitching a 50-run stand. Yes, they did have luck on their side but take nothing away from their innings. They were scoring runs at will and both looked set for a big score. But after the drinks break, Kumara's short ball did the trick by removing Hope. Rangana Herath then, got into the action as he got his first in the form of Chase. After the two set batsmen were gone, the runs also started to choke and Sri Lanka now have a firm hold on this game. They would want more of the same in the next session. Whereas, the Windies would hope someone to stay out there and score big. Join us for the third and the last session in a while.
A good delivery to finish this session! On a length around off, it is equally well played by Dowrich as he defends it onto the ground. TEA ON DAY 1!
Attacks the stumps this time and Shane gets his bat down and keeps it out.
Another ball outside off, maybe some plan here by Gamage. The batsman though is not tempted as he leaves it again.
Wide outside off, Gamage wants the batsman to go after it again. Dowrich does the right thing by leaving it.
Back of a length on off, defended it onto the back foot.
Another poor shot! Lapse in concentration? Maybe. Last over before Tea, you should be letting such balls go to the keeper. It is short and outside off, Dowrich tries to cut but gets beaten.
Another appeal but nothing from the umpire! It is down the leg side. Holder misses the flick and the keeper collects it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Another tossed up ball outside off, Holder strokes it through covers for a brace.
FOUR! Gets off the mark after 11 balls with a very good shot! This is a touch fuller by Hearth on middle, Holder whips it through wide mid on for a boundary. 150 up for the Windies.

NOT OUT! It has bounced just before it hits the boot. A poor shot though by Holder. Yes, he wants to get off the mark but this is not the shot to play at the moment. Herath tosses this one up on off, it is again the arm ball and it keeps coming in. Holder goes for the expansive drive through covers but gets an inside edge. It hits his boot and lobs towards silly point where Mendis takes it and appeals. The umpire is not sure whether it has bounced before hitting the boot and hence he takes it upstairs. Replays roll in and they clearly show the ball to be bouncing. Holder survives.
Has Holder hit it onto his boot? The Sri Lankan players do feel so. The umpires want to check it upstairs and the soft signal is not out.
Flighted ball on off, Holder defends it.
Good change of length there. A surprise short ball on off. Dowrich ducks under it. Three maidens in a row for Sri Lanka.
Hits the length again on off, Dowrich can't do a lot with it. He rocks back and defends it onto the ground.
Back of a length on off, Dowrich defends it onto the ground.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Works it to mid-wicket with the angle.
Another length ball on off, Dowrich defends it onto the ground.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Driven through mid off by the batsman.
Another flighted ball on middle, Holder drives it to mid off.
Loopy ball on off, Holder drives it off the middle but it hits the man at silly point.
Works it with the angle to the man at mid-wicket.
