Flighted ball on off, Holder defends it onto the front foot.
Goes back to bowling length and the batsman defends it.
Nice shot but for no runs! Fuller in length on off, Dowrich times it nicely to the man at covers.
Back of a length on off, defended.
Length ball on off, Dowrich pushes it to covers.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.
Good length on off, Dowrich defends it on the front foot.
Lahiru Gamage is back on.
Drives it to the man at mid on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated this on off, Holder defends it on the front foot.
Jason Holder walks out to the middle.

OUT! What a catch! That flew towards Mathews at first slip and he has taken an excellent reflex catch. Also this is smart bowling by the wily veteran. He bowls this a touch quicker and flatter on off. It comes in with the angle. Chase goes onto the back foot and tries to punch it through the off side. The ball pitches straightens a touch, takes the outside edge and goes quickly towards Mathews. He reacts well and takes a sharp catch. Herath gets his first and another Windies batsman fails to convert a start. Two quick wickets for Sri Lanka and Windies now have half the side back in the hut. Sri Lanka on top here.
Works it with the angle through square leg for a single.
Flighted ball on off, the batsman defends it onto the ground.
The off spinner on middle, Chase with the turn works it to the man at square leg.
Flatter outside off, Chase guides it to point.
Dowrich this time eases it to long on for a run.
Bowls it a touch fuller on middle, Chase eases it to long on and gets to the other end.
Similar delivery to the last one. Chase again defends it.
Flighted ball on off, Chase lunges and keeps it out.
Attacks the stumps now in the hope of an LBW or a bowled. Dowrich gets right behind the line and defends it.
Bowls a loopy one outside off, looking for an outside edge this time to the slip fielder. Dowrich however, middles it but finds the man at covers.
Down the leg side, looking for a faint edge as the batsman tries to clip it fine. Dowrich misses and the keeper collects it well.
Gives it a lot of air this time. Chase pushes it towards mid on for a run. The fielder scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but the batsman is well in.
Flighted delivery on middle, Chase pushes it back to the bowler.
Floats it up on off, it is driven to the man at mid off.
Rangana Herath is back on.
Out come the physio once again. He gives Chase some tablets. Pain killers maybe as his hand might still be hurting. Also a new pair of inners come out for him.
Loopy ball on off, the batsman blocks it.
Works it with the turn on the leg side for a run.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Fires it on the pads, the batsman goes back and tries to whip it but misses to get hit on it. The ball rolls towards square leg for a leg bye.
Flighted ball on off, Dowrich prods forward and keeps it out.
Floats it up on off, Dowrich lunges and defends it onto the ground.
Back of a length on off, Chase pushes it back to the bowler.
Hits the deck hard on off, Chase off the back foot defends it onto the ground.
A short one down the leg side. Chase lets it be. This is good aggressive bowling by Kumara.
A very good follow-up delivery, a yorker on off. Chase however, is up for it as he gets his bat down in time and defends it.
The physio makes his way out and it is time for the magic spray to show its magic. It does and Chase is now fine to continue.
Nasty! Another excellent short delivery at 139 kph. It rushes onto the batsman. Chase tries to defend it by hopping but the ball gets big on him. It hits him on the gloves.
Good length on off, Chase defends it onto the ground.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A similar ball and a similar shot like the last one.
Gives it air on middle, Dowrich goes back and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball on off, Chase pushes it through covers for a run.
FOUR! Makes the mistake of going too full and Chase takes full toll of it. He leans into it and strokes it through covers for a boundary.
Flighted ball on middle, Chase works it with the turn to the man at mid-wicket.
Another good length ball on off, Dowrich defends it off the back foot. The ball hits the toe end of his bat. Should be coming forward to that delivery.
A full toss, he does bowl one every now and then. Chase this time though does not take full toll of it as he guides it through point for a run.
Another ball wide outside off, Chase lets it be.
Good length outside off, left alone.
On the pads, Dowrich works it through square leg for a run.
Shane Dowrich is the new man in.

OUT! Hope's luck runs out! Once again it is that man, Lahiru Kumara who provides the breakthrough by breaking the 54-run stand. He got his first off a fuller delivery and this time the short ball does the trick. It is aimed at the rib cage of the batsman. Hope tries to nudge it down the leg side but it kisses his gloves on the way and goes towards the keeper. Dickwella moves to his left and takes it on the second attempt. The players appeal and up goes the finger. Hope walks back dejected six short of his half ton.
Works it with the turn to the man at mid-wicket. A maiden for Dilruwan but no purchase for him off the surface.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter but quicker on the stumps, Chase rocks back and punches it to mid on.
Flighted ball on off, Chase plants his front foot forward and drives it to the man at mid on.
Flatter this time on off, gets it to bounce a touch more. Chase defends it off the back foot.
Starts off with a tossed up delivery on off, Chase lunges forward and defends it.
Dilruwan Perera is back into the attack.
On a good length outside off, Shai Hope lets it through.

Drinks break. The hour after Lunch interval has gone in the way of the home team. Shai Hope had a couple of close calls but survived both of those and then went on to stitch a 54-run unbeaten partnership with Roston Chase. West Indies have cultivated 35 runs so far in this session and are yet to lose a wicket.
Touch too straight from Kumara, the right-hander works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SO CLOSE! A rare loose shot from Chase. He plays a drive without moving his feet too much. Plays it loosely away from the body and misses it as the ball straightens a little.
Bowls a shortish delivery to Chase, who defends it with utmost ease.
Pacy delivery right in the blockhole, Shai Hope slices it wide of gully for a single.
Serves a good length ball on off, angling in, Hope covers his stumps and shoulders arms to it.
Tosses it full outside off, the right-hander powers the drive to the fielder at covers.
Slanting down leg, the batsman backs away to flick that but it goes off the inner half to fine leg. They take a couple.
Stands tall and punches it to the cover region.

Darts it on the pads and Chase flicks it to deep square leg for a brace. Brings up the 50-run partnership with Shai Hope for the fourth wicket. A good stand for the hosts and they will hope these two carry on for a long time.
Pushes it firmly to mid off. The fielder attacks the ball and prevents the single.
Faster one from Herath on middle, Chase defends it out.
Hope lunges on the front foot and gets closer to the pitch of  the delivery. Drives it to the man at mid off.
Intelligent batting, gets off strike with a single. Drops it on the leg side and calls for a run. Gets it with ease.
A wide delivery, left alone by Roston Chase.

FOUR! Smart shot from Chase. He sees a wide delivery, full outside off, plays away from the body but executes it to perfection. Slices it wide of the man at gully and the ball races away to the third man fence.
Good length ball on off, the batsman doesn't play at that one.
Attempts a yorker straightaway, but misses it by a few inches. Chase takes it on the full and flicks it to mid on.
Lahiru Kumara comes onto bowl.
Pushes it quicker through the air, the batsman works it to the vacant mid-wicket region. Ends the over with a single.
Plays with hard hands and pushes it back to the bowler.
Darts this on the stumps, Chase blocks it off the front foot.
Gives it some air, full ball outside off, Chase firmly pushes it to covers.
Powers it to cover-point, where Kusal Perera manages to stop it. Single taken.
Loopy delivery outside off, Hope gets towards the pitch of it and blocks it right in front of his eyes.
Rangana Herath comes back for a new spell.
Widish delivery to end the over, Chase deliberately plays a long way inside the line of it and lets it go.

FOUR! Great strike from Chase! Fullish delivery outside off, moves further away from the batsman, who chases it and makes good contact with the ball. Square drives it past the diving backward point fielder for a boundary. Moves to 18 with that shot.
Bowls from wide of the crease and looks to slant that in but ends up dishing it outside off. Chase lets it through.
On a length outside off, Chase plays a drive towards backward point.
Defends it solidly down the track.
A seam up delivery on the fifth stump channel, Chase judges it well and lets it go.
Plays a drive with the bat face open, but finds the fielder at backward point.
Suranga Lakmal is feeling sick and he is standing outside the field. The physio is standing next to him giving medicine to the pacer.
The right-hander stays in his crease and offers the straight bat as he defends it out.

FOUR! Well-timed by Hope! Fuller length ball, jags back at pace, Hope plants his front foot forward but makes the adjustment quickly. He whips it to the right of the man at mid on. The ball motors away to the boundary.
Punches it off the back foot, but finds the man at extra cover.
Tailing in from outside off, Shai Hope plants his front foot across and drives. He mistimes it past the bowler and it rolls towards mid on.
Sliding down leg, Hope goes back and tries to glance that but fails to make contact with the leather.
Chase gets a decent stride forward and blocks it towards covers.
Bowls from wide of the crease, angling it in, but still wide of the off stump and Chase decides to shoulders arms.
Wide delivery from Lakmal, Chase doesn't play at it. The bowler is disappointed by his effort.
Chase jumps on the back foot and taps it towards backward point.
Fullish delivery on off, Chase plays a drive, but it goes off the bottom half past gully towards third man. They take a couple.
Nearly finds the outside edge! Back of a length ball, moves away after pitching, Chase plays for the initial line and he is beaten all ends up.
Pulls his length back after getting driven, Hope hangs back and defends it solidly.

FOUR! Fine shot!  This will give Hope a lot of confidence. He had an iffy start in this session but he has put all that behind. Gets a fullish delivery, leans towards the pitch of it and caresses it through the covers. The ball races away to the boundary.
Slips it on the pads and the batsman whips it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Cracking cover drive from Hope, but the fielder at extra cover dives to his right and partly stops it. Single taken.
Smashes it back to the bowler, who gets a hand to it and takes pace off it. Good shot for no run.

Play and a miss! Fullish delivery on the driveable length, Hope doesn't get to the pitch of it and still goes for the shot. He misses it as the ball straightens a little and whistles past the outside edge.
Widish delivery on off and the batsman is happy to leave those.
No ball! Fullish delivery outside off, Chase lets it go. Lakmal has overstepped and that's another extra added to the total.
Goes right back and defends it square on to the off side.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Chase isn't sure which way the ball is moving as he jabs at this one. Gets an inside edge on the pads.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Lovely delivery. Hits the seam and moves away just a little, the batsman looks to defend that but he is beaten by the away swing.
Well outside off and the batsman decides to leave it.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

NOT OUT! Shai Hope survives to fight another day! Excellent use of the review! A sharp in-dipper from Gamage, Shai Hope tries to keep it out off the back foot by hoping and keeping his bat and pad close. It seems to have hit the pad first and the players make a huge appeal. The umpire agrees and is quick to raise his finger. Seeing the decision go against him, Hope decides to take the review immediately. No issues with the front foot on this occasion and we move further. There is a spike on the Ultra Edge but did the ball clip his front leg first? I am in the opinion of it clipping the pad first, but the Television umpire thinks otherwise. He is happy to overturn the on-field call.
Shai Hope has been adjudged LBW and he calls for a referral straightaway. Will the visitors get their 4th wicket? or Is there an inside edge to save Hope?
Angling in from outside off, much closer to the off stump, Shai Hope defends it solidly.
Seeing it too wide, Hope decides to let it go.
Fullish delivery on the stumps, Hope goes across and pushes it to the mid on region.
A delivery outside off from Lakmal and we see another leave from Chase. End of a harmless maiden from Lakmal.
Easily leave for the right-hander.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Well wide of the off stump and Roston doesn't play at it.
Sits back in his crease and defends it out.
Slightly wide from Lakmal and the batsman decides to let it go.
Suranga Lakmal is back into the attack.
FOUR! Good shot! That is like rubbing salt to the wound of Gamage. A widish delivery and the batsman powers it through the covers for a boundary.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
No shot offered by Hope.

No ball! Yes, Gamage has spoiled the fun for Sri Lanka! Short of a length ball outside off, the batsman plays a loose shot away from the body and gets a thick edge through to the keeper. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Shai Hope starts walking back but he has been stopped by the umpire who wants to check for the front foot no ball. Time for the replays and it is very marginal. After several looks, it is ruled in favor of the batsman. A big let off for Hope. How costly will this prove? Hope will surely want to make them pay here. The 100 comes up with that extra.
Have Sri Lanka got another wicket or has Gamage messed it up? The umpire wants to check the front foot no ball. Looks pretty tight.
Attacks the stumps, Shai goes right behind it and defends it back to the bowler.
Serves a seam up delivery, full on off, the batsman plays a drive to the left of mid off.
Gamage pulls out at the last moment.
On a length outside off, Hope covers his off stump and decides to leave that one.
Welcome back. Shai Hope and Roston Chase will resume their innings. While for Sri Lanka, Lahiru Gamage has the ball.
... Day 1, Session 2 ...

A session with which maybe both the teams will be happy. Runs came at a good pace but wickets too fell at regular intervals. The Windies after electing to bat got off to the worst start possible as Lakmal got Brathwaite early. Powell and Smith did try to steady the ship but lazy running from the latter saw him gifting his wicket to the visitors. Powell however along with Hope stitched another 40-run stand before Powell was castled by Kumara. Windies now have Hope and Chase, who has started well out there. They would hope for the two to build a big association. Whereas, Lanka would hope for some early wickets after the break. Join us for the second session in a while.
Nicely bowled! Goes wide of the crease and angles this into the batsman. It pitches and shapes away. Chase tries to keep it out but is beaten. LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Shortish on off, Hope punches it towards wide mid off for a run.
WIDE! Not often do you see a wide bowled in a Test game. This is outside off, very outside off I should say. The batsman lets it be and the umpire stretches his hands.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it on off, Hope defends it onto the ground.
Back of a length on off, Hope keeps it out.
Back of a length on off, Hope pushes it to mid off. He needs to hit this length on regular basis.
Down the leg side, Hope fails to clip it away. It hits his pads and goes down to fine leg. Two leg byes taken by the batsmen.
Flatter again on middle, Chase punches it to the man at mid on.
Fires it on middle, Chase pushes it to mid on.

FOUR! A little too full and Herath pays the price. He gives it a lot of air and it lands on the fuller side outside off. The turn is out of contention as Chase leans into it and strokes it towards covers. The fielder there dives but does not manage to stop it and the ball races away. Runs are flowing since the fall of the wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy ball on off, Chase defends it onto the ground.
Flighted ball on off, Chase drives it to covers.
FOUR! Hope says thank you this time as he gets another short ball. He feeds on such deliveries as he rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Another low full toss, Chase gets his bat down in time and flicks it through mid-wicket for three.
FOUR! Goes for the yorker but ends up giving a full toss. Chase says thank you so much and he eases it through mid on to get off the mark in style.
Welcomes the new man with a quick bouncer. Chase ducks under it.
Roston Chase strides out to the middle.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! The fuller ball does the trick and the much-needed breakthrough has been provided by Kumara. He fires it on middle, it shapes back in a touch and late. Powell is rooted in his crease as he tries to drive it. The ball takes the inside edge and goes onto hit the leg stump. Kumara is pumped and Powell walks back after getting a start. The Windies in a spot of bother here.
FOUR! Excellent use of the wrists there! A touch short and on the pads, Hope goes back and whips it through mid-wicket. There is no fielder in the deep and a boundary results.
Flighted ball on off, it is pushed to mid off.
Fires this outside off, Powell cuts it late down to backward point for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Another loopy ball on middle, Powell blocks it. Not a lot of purchase as of now for Herath.
Floats it up on off, Powell lunges forward and keeps it out.

Poor bowling! The Sri Lankan bowlers are not learning here. Not a good idea to bowl it short to Hope and Kumara does exactly that. There is also width on offer outside off. Hope cuts it through cover-point. The fielder in the deep runs to his right, dives and saves a couple. 8 from the over.

An ambitious appeal by the bowler there! On the pads, Powell goes to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The ball rolls on the leg side, the batsman run a leg bye.
Hits the deck hard on off, Hope guides it down towards third man for a run.

FOUR! Exquisite! His fourth boundary and this is the best of the lot. He also holds the pose for the cameras. Full and on off, Hope prods forward and times it beautifully through covers and there is no stopping that ball.
Length ball and on the stumps, Hope defends it to mid on.
Back of a length on off, Hope punches it to covers.
A brace through the leg side this time. Works it with the turn through square leg and the batsmen take two.
Shortish and on off, Powell rocks back and punches it through the off side. There is a sweeper in place and the batsmen get two.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter and on off, Powell defends it onto the ground.
No problem there as he lunges forward and blocks it.
Once again Powell does not look comfortable playing Herath here. He uses his feet and tries to flick but gets an inside edge, away from the short leg fielder and towards square leg.
Shorter and down the leg side. Hope tries to nudge it but misses.
FOUR! Goes for the glory ball but ends up giving a gift. A full toss on off, Hope leans into it and strokes it through cover-point for a boundary. Three boundaries in his 13, dealing in them.

The sucker ball almost does the trick! Good bowling. Serves it very full and outside off, wanting the batsman to go after it. Hope does so as he flashes at it away from the body. Luckily for him he misses it and does not edge it.
Good length on off, Hope defends it onto the ground.
Outside off, left alone.

FOUR! Easy-peasy for Hope! How much do the Windies batsmen love the short ball? That shot will answer all your questions. A bumper on middle, Hope gets into position and pulls it crisply through mid-wicket. The ball reaches to the fence in no time.
Another straighter one outside off. Once again Powell plays for the turn and the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Nicely bowled! The slider outside off, Powell plays for the turn but there ain't any. He is beaten.
FOUR! Poor ball and put away! A touch short and outside off, Powell rocks back and punches it through covers. The ball races away to the fence. Powell moves onto 33.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Uses his feet but Hearth spots that. He fires it down the leg side. Powell tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Creates problems first up! Tosses this up on off, it skids off the surface. Powell tries to defend but gets a leading edge back to the bowler.
The most successful left arm spinner, Rangana Herath, is into the attack.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Beaten! Length ball around off, this one shapes away. Hope tries to defend but is beaten by the movement.

Almost kicked his stumps over there Powell! On the shorter side and on leg stump. Powell hops back and flicks it towards fine leg. In the process he slips, falls onto the ground, recovers and completes the run.
Back of a length on middle, Powell defends it onto the off side.
Good length on off, it is slanting away. Powell defends it onto the ground.
A good bumper on middle, Powell easily ducks under it.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man.
Short and outside off, Hope tries to cut but finds the fielder at covers. He will be disappointed there as a scoring opportunity goes abegging.
Back of a length on off, Hope pushes it to mid off.
Attacks the stumps, Hope blocks it.
This time it is outside off. The batsman need not play at those. No swing on offer.

Late swing there! Gamage goes for the yorker and it tails back in very late from middle. Hope tries to flick but misses and Dickwella behind the stumps does well once again. Luckily for Hope that swings a little too much. Had that been on the stumps, it could have been trouble for him.
Now tries to bounce the batsman out but does not get the desired bounce. Hope nudges it down to fine leg for a run. 50 up for the Windies.
Good thinking by the bowler! Goes for a fast yorker but ends up serving a low full toss. Hope maybe is not expecting it but gets his bat down in time and keeps it out awkwardly.
Back of a length on off, Hope once again is solid in defense.
Attacks the off pole and lands it on a length. Hope confidently defends it back to the bowler.
Shortish again and this one skids off the surface. Powell tries to flick but misses to get hit high on the thigh pad. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batsmen run a leg bye.

A wayward start for him! It is short and way down the leg side. Powell goes for the pull but misses it by a long way. Dickwella does really well to dive to his right and save four runs for his team. He is applauded by his teammates for that effort.
Finally a break for Lakmal as Lahiru Kumara comes into the attack.
Fuller this time and outside off, trying to get the ball to swing back in. It does not and Hope leaves it.
Goes back to bowling length outside off. Hope lets it be.

FOUR! 1000 runs in Test cricket for Shai Hope and he gets there in style!  Picks the length quickly as it is a touch short on middle. Sits up to be hit, Hope swivels inside his crease and pulls it disdainfully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Better from the bowler! Bowls it closer to the off stump. Hope rocks back and defends it onto the ground.
Another ball a little too wide outside off, Hope makes another leave.
Starts off with a loosener outside off. Hope does not fiddle with it.
Lahiru Gamage is back on.
The physio now comes out to have a look. The good thing though for the Windies is Powell is back on his feet and now is all ready to go.
This is very good bowling! He shapes this one back in. Powell tries to flick but misses to get hit near the box. He is down in some pain.
Got the last one to come back in. Slants this one away from the batsman. Powell however, watchfully makes a leave.
Back of a length around off, this one comes back in sharply. Powell tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.

FOUR! Top shot! Powell is really looking good out there. This is on the fuller side on off, Lakmal was hoping for it to swing but it did not. Easy pickings for Powell as he leans into it and drives it through mid off for a boundary.
No signs of any tiredness there! A jaffa! On a length around off, this one slants away from the batsman. Powell tries to keep it out off the back foot but gets beaten.
Signs of tiring? Bowls it a little too wide outside off, the batsman needs not play at those.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shai Hope is the new man in.
Drinks break.

OUT! Smith has to depart! Replays show he is short and Sri Lanka get a bonus breakthrough! A run out in a Test match is disheartening and the comeback man just found that. A sad end for Smith, who would have wanted to make an impression in his first innings after a hiatus of few years from Test cricket. Coming to the run out, Powell dabs it to the left of the mid-wicket fielder and calls for a risky single. Lahiru Kumara gathers it cleanly and throws it to the keeper, who breaks the stumps in a flash. Smith didn't put in the dive nor did he rush towards his end. Overall, a lazy effort from the left-hander and a little more agility might have saved him there. He only has himself to blame and needs to work on his running!
Poorly judged single, will it cost WI on this occasion? Smith is the man in question. Looked OUT to the naked eye. Will Smith survive? Replays roll in.
Flatter ball, Powell powers it through the covers and a couple added to the total.
Sits back in his crease and defends it solidly.

Charges down the track and reaches out for the ball. Misses it and gets hit on the pads. Loud shout from Dickwella, but besides him nobody from the visiting team were interested. Impact was outside the line and Powell was attempting a shot.
Slider, angling in from outside off, the batsman pushes it on the off side.
Ends his sixth over with a fullish delivery on the stumps, Smith gets a small stride forward and defends it out. Second  maiden over from the pacer.
Lakmal bowls a wide delivery and gets no response from the batsman.
Defended by Smith off the back foot.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Smith gets high on his toes and looks to play the square cut to a delivery which is pretty close to his body. Ends up getting an under edge which just misses the stumps by an inches.
Hit on the pads and there is an appeal, but it dies down pretty quickly. Good length ball, nips back after pitching, the batsman is hit on the front leg. Maybe, it was too high!
Dabs it on the off side and looks for a quick single but his partner denies. Rightly so, that would have been a risky single had they gone for it.

FOUR! A freebie from Dilruwan and the batsman milks it for a boundary. Shortish delivery outside off, Powell stays back and slaps it between backward point and cover-point for a boundary. This pair has already added 34 for the second wicket.
Powell gets right behind it and defends it on the track.
Angling in from outside off, Powell sits on the back foot and defends it out.
Punched off the backfoot by the batsman.
Time for some spin. Dilruwan Perera comes into the attack replacing Lahiru Gamage.
Jumps down the track and seeing that, the offie bowls it touch wide. The batsman manages to defend it.
Drops it on the off side and calls for a quick single. Perera attacks the ball but misses the stumps at the bowler's end. Single completed.
Smartly, brings this one back into the batsman, who expected that. Goes back and taps it on the leg side.
Brilliant comeback from Lakmal, he bowls from over the wicket and angles it away from the batsman. The ball jumps sharple and seams away a little. Misses the outside edge by a whisker.
Closes the face of the bat and taps it on the leg side.

FOUR! Good shot! No need to run for that. Lakmal bowls a wide delivery and Powell capitalizes on it. Hangs back and slaps it behind backward point for a boundary. Don't bother running, nobody is going to stop that. He has already played a few lovely shots in his short stay so far.
Slipping down the leg side, the batsman tries to flick it but isn't able to make contact with the leather.
Pushes it gently to the cover region for a single. The fielder is slightly deep and they get across with ease.
FOUR Leg byes! Errs in line and pays for it. Dishes out a half volley down the leg side. The batsman tries to glance it but misses. The ball hits the boot and races past the keeper for a boundary.
Third leave off the over. Lahiru needs to make batsman play against this new ball.
Touch wider from Gamage and the southpaw leaves it with ease.
LOOSE SHOT! An away going delivery outside off, swings further away, Powell goes for the drive but fails to make contact with the ball.
Powell goes on the back foot and lifts his bat as he lets it through to the keeper.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
No ball! Lakmal oversteps on this occasion and the umpire is quick to stretch his arm. A good length ball, defended back to the bowler.

Smith is safe! He just manages to put his bat down in time and completes the single eventually. Powell dabs it on the off side and calls for a quick single. His partner is quick to respond, so is Chandimal, who gets to the ball. Picks it cleanly and hits bull's eye at the striker's end. Replays are in and it shows the man on his comeback game is good to continue.
Appeal for a run out. There is a direct hit at the keeper's end, the Sri Lankan fielders are confident and the umpire takes it upstairs. Smith didn't drag his bat, did he get across in time???
Beaten! Top nut from Suranga Lakmal! Slightly shorter in length and straightens after pitching, the batsman ends up playing down the wrong line and the ball whizzes past the outside edge of his bat.
Change of angle from Lakmal. Bowls from around the wicket and swings it into the pads. Powell flicks it to the left of Herath at mid on for a brace.
FOUR! Flicks it with nice timing and picks up his second boundary! Lakmal dishes out one on the pads and the batsman clips it off his pads through square leg for a boundary.
On the off stump line, Powell goes back and defends a good length delivery solidly on the off side.
Gets it much straighter after a few wide deliveries, Powell has to play at it but gets a thickish inside edge to deep backward square, where Lakmal does the mopping work.
Away swinger from Gamage, pitches it outside off and swings further away. The batsman doesn't feel the need to play.
Gamage loses his radar, bowls this one wide outside off and the batsman doesn't play at it.
And another good leave from the southpaw.
Well left by the batsman, he is sure where his off stump is and lets it through.

FOUR! Shot! Powell opens his account with a delightful straight drive! Fuller length ball, touch too full from Gamage, the batsman gets into the right position, presents the full face and creams it past his partner. The ball scoots to the long off fence.
Hangs back to defend that, but it goes off the inner half on the leg side. End of a testing over from Lakmal.
Shaping in sharply, after pitching. Smith goes right back and manages to defend it down the track.
Inswinger from Lakmal, Smith uses his wrists and flicks it for a couple past mid-wicket.
In the air... lands safely! Shortish delivery, rearing up at pace, Smith stands tall to fend that. The ball hits high on the bat and balloons on the off side and rolls to backward point.
Leg bye! Slipping down leg and Powell tries to flick it, misses and the ball goes off his pads behind square leg. They take a leg bye.
Jumps on the back foot and defends it out.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Prodigious away movement for Gamage, pitches it well outside leg and jags away at pace, the batsman misses it by some distance as he looks to drive that.
Smith goes on the back foot to defend that, he gets an inside edge on the pads.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.

FOUR! Uppish but safe. A fullish delivery outside off, Smith plays slightly away from the body and plays it on the up. Mistimes it a little but manages to beat the man at backward point. The ball races away to the boundary. First boundary of the innings.
Smith goes on the back foot and decides to leave that one.

A muted appeal but nothing from the umpire. This is on the shorter side and on the body. Powell tries to clip it down the leg side but the ball brushes his thigh pad and goes to the keeper. He appeals but the umpire is not interested. A wicket-maiden by Lakmal comes to an end.
Bowls a short one down the leg side. Powell lets it be.
Kieran Powell walks out to the middle.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Lakmal draws first blood. He gets his man. This was on the cards. He beat the outside edge a couple of times in this over and he finally induces one. Suranga lands this on a length around off, it shapes away late. Brathwaite has to play at it due to the original line but is done in by the movement away. The ball kisses the outside edge and goes to the right of Dickwella who dives and takes a good catch. An early wicket for Sri Lanka and it is the big one of Brathwaite. The visitors are ecstatic. Perfect start for them.
Not  a lot of swing this time as he lands it on the stumps. Brathwaite defends it back to the bowler.
Another beauty! Quite similar to the last one. This was on a length and around off, it shapes away late again. Brathwaite pokes at it and gets beaten.

WOW! Too good a delivery to get a wicket! Length ball on the off stump line and moves away at a good pace, Brathwaite plays down the wrong line and misses it. There is a huge appeal for caught behind but the umpire stays put. Noise was of the ball clipping the flap of his back leg.
Back of a length ball outside off, the batsman opens the face of the bat and dabs it to gully. The fielder dives to his right and stops it.

Another inside edge, Brathwaite constantly being troubled by that inswing. Moves in sharply from a length, the batsman somehow manages to put bat to ball and it goes off the inner half to fine leg. Single taken.
Slightly wider from Gamage and the batsman decides to leave that one.
Again, some appreciable inward movement from Gamage, catches the inside edge and the ball rolls on the leg side.
First run for Devon Smith on his return! Defends it on to the off side and calls for a quick single. He gets a positive response from his partner.
OHHH! Off the inside edge. A sharp incoming delivery from Gamage, Kraigg goes back to defend that, but the ball goes off the inner half to square leg. Another run added to the total.
Lahiru Gamage will share the new ball with Lakmal. He played a decent role against a series versus Pakistan, but his figures don't do justice to his efforts.
Fullish delivery, tailing in just a wee bit, Devon jumps back and defensively pushes it back to the bowler. A tidy start from Lakmal.
First run for WI. Fuller length ball, fractionally too straight from Lakmal, the batsman works it to the right of Herath at mid-wicket. They take a single.
Brathwaite hangs back in his crease and dabs it to the man at short leg.
Again, a shortish delivery from Lakmal, pushing the batsman on the back foot, who defends it back to him.
Now, he tries a shortish delivery, two balls and two different lengths from Lakmal. The batsman defends it on the track.
Some swing for the pacer straightaway! Lakmal starts with a good delivery in line with the stumps, Brathwaite goes back, covers the away swing and defends it back to the bowler.

We are all set for the action to get underway. Out come the umpires and the players. Kraigg Brathwaite and Devon Smith are the openers for the Windies. Suranga Lakmal will bowl the first over for Sri Lanka. He has three slips, a gully and a short leg in place. Here we go...

Dinesh Chandimal, the Sri Lankan skipper, states he wanted to bat first, but isn't disappointed to bowl first. He wants his team to focus on one game at a time. He mentions Rangana is the only player in this team who played in the last tour to the Windies. About team combination, he informs, they have got five bowlers, comprising of three pacers and two spinners.

Jason Holder, the West Indian skipper, says he wants to bat first and wants to post a good score on the board. He thinks, last year was a good one for his side and wants to continue on the same vein. Informs, they have gone with five genuine batters and the same number of bowlers.
TOSS - Heads is the call from Dinesh Chandimal but tails it is. West Indies win the toss and opt to bat first.

PITCH REPORT - Sunil Gavaskar, the Indian legendary top-order batsman, starts his pitch analysis by saying that the weather is pretty good. He feels cracks will open up as the game progresses and spinners will enjoy bowling on this wicket. However, he informs it will be a true batting surface and team winning the toss should bat first.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the 1st Test between West Indies and Sri Lanka. The Asian team hasn't toured the Caribbean nation for over a decade and it will be a challenge of all sorts for the visitors to adapt to the conditions. Windies, on the other hand, haven't been in the greatest of rhythm in the longer format of game and they will be desperate for a win. Two teams enter this game with the same ambition and we can expect a good tussle between equally-matched sides. Stay tuned as we bring you the toss in a while!
